pages._note: platform-integrations-catalogue (design D1-D3, hydra connection-registry D8/D9). The rows are integriq's app_connection objects, synced from lib/Settings/connections.json; integriq works out each status, humaniq only declares them and reports the ledger handoff. config.filter scopes the list to humaniq, also for a bookmarked link. showAdd is false because a row nothing declared has nothing to check; Add integration leaves for integriq's overview through the openIntegriqConnections handler, since a header action's navigate only pushes a route inside this app. The two formatters are nextcloud-vue built-ins. Without integriq the menu entry hides and requiresApp names the missing app on a deep link. The access-grant records stay on IntegrationAccounts (Access grants).
